text: STUDENT HOSTEL CODE OF CONDUCT & OUTPASS POLICY (2026) ==================================================== 1. DAILY SHORT-TERM OUTINGS: - Students are permitted daily outings between 4:30 PM and 8:30 PM on weekdays. - On weekends and public holidays, outings are permitted from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM. - Every student must scan their unique digital QR pass at the security gate before leaving and upon return. - Late entry past 9:00 PM without prior written warden permission will result in an automated fine and notificatio 2. LONG-TERM HOME PASS GUIDELINES: - Home Pass applications must be submitted at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled departure date. - A Home Pass is valid only after formal approval by the Hostel Warden or Deputy Warden. - Students cannot exit the main security gate on a Home Pass until the status reflects 'Approved' in the system - The gatekeeper verifies the student's identity against the approved pass before granting gate departure.

HOSTEL BLOCKS, DISCIPLINE & MEDICAL PROTOCOL =========================================== 3. HOSTEL BLOCKS & OCCUPANCY: - Campus hostels comprise Boys Hostel A, Boys Hostel B, Girls Hostel A, and Girls Hostel B. - Students must reside strictly in their assigned room numbers. - Inter-block movement after 9:30 PM is strictly prohibited. 4. EMERGENCY & MEDICAL VISITS: - In case of sudden illness or medical emergency, the security gatekeeper or resident warden may authorize im - The security guard will select 'Medical' as the outing reason and alert the campus clinic. 5. DIGITAL QR PASS DISCIPLINE: - Digital QR passes are non-transferable.
